notes: Adds a 'Block all Tor exit nodes now' button on Security > Settings, for shutting down Tor-routed abuse immediately instead of waiting for each IP to hit the gateway once - it queues the whole current exit-node list and registers it with cPanel 5 requests at a time in the background (usually done within a few minutes even for a large list), instead of the old one-at-a-time reactive blocking. Also fixes a gap where manually 'Unblock'-ing an IP from Blocked IPs (single or bulk) only unblocked it locally and left it rejected by cPanel forever - it now lifts the cPanel-side block too, so gradually restoring IPs after a temporary bulk block actually works. No database update needed for this update.
